$comment: Owner-editable settings. storeUrl: paste the real (public) Google Play listing URL when it exists; every download button then becomes the Google Play badge. testUrl: a Google Play testing opt-in link (Play Console's 'Join on the web'); used only while storeUrl is empty, as 'Install the test version' with a note that it is for invited testers. testAndroidUrl: Play Console's 'Join on Android' link for the same test; when set, the note and the download section offer both links. With neither, buttons read 'Coming to Google Play'. siteUrl: the deployed root (change it when a custom domain is added). Items in knownPlaceholders are owner inputs still outstanding (see docs/OWNER-DETAILS-NEEDED.md); scripts/check.mjs fails if a page publishes any other [... REQUIRED] marker.
legalEntity: the trading name of Kalyana Lakkamraju, a sole trader based in Witham, Essex, United Kingdom

seo.$comment: googleSiteVerification: the content value of Search Console's HTML-tag verification (docs/SEO-MANUAL-STEPS.md, Step 4). Leave empty until you have it; the tag is then added to the home page.
